[1] Caution, not to make our moves too hastily... Chess was occasionally criticized in the 19th century as a waste of time. Chess is taught to children in schools around the world today. Chess is also present in contemporary popular culture. [2] More recent research has focused on chess as mental training; the respective roles of knowledge and look-ahead search; brain imaging studies of chess masters and novices; blindfold chess; the role of personality and intelligence in chess skill; gender differences; and computational models of chess expertise.
